name: Odile
title: Sage of the Arcanum
examine: Smells of dried moonbell and old paper. Reads three books at once and finishes all of them.
lines: Formulas and treatises, copied fair. The brewing is still on you.
Knowledge keeps better than bread and costs more. As it should.
The capstone treatises? Not on my shelf. The deep places keep those.
Mind the lectern. It's older than the town and twice as stubborn.
